definitions.gloss: dumbfounded, stunned, in a daze, stupefied
definitions.explanation: A state of being so shocked, surprised, or overwhelmed that one cannot think or react. Often describes standing or sitting motionless in disbelief.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{呆然|ぼうぜん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{立|た}ち{尽|つ}くした。
⟦{突然|とつぜん}→突然：00409_totsuzen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{知|し}らせ→知らせ：03252_shirase⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{呆然|ぼうぜん}とした。
examples.english: I was stunned by the sudden news.

examples.japanese: ⟦{火事|かじ}→火事：01283_kaji⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{失|うしな}った→失う：01887_ushinau⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧たち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{焼|や}け{跡|あと}→焼け跡：27607_yakeato⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{呆然|ぼうぜん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{立|た}っていた→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧。
examples.english: The people who had lost their homes in the fire stood dazed in front of the burned remains.

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
Taru-adjective. Used adverbially as {呆然|ぼうぜん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧ (in a daze) or attributively as {呆然|ぼうぜん}たる (dazed). The adverbial form {呆然|ぼうぜん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧ is far more common.

USAGE:
Almost always paired with physical descriptions of immobility: {立|た}ち{尽|つ}くす (to stand rooted), ⟦{座|すわ}り{込|こ}む→座り込む：04641_suwarikomu⟧ (to collapse into sitting), ⟦{見|み}つめる→見つめる：04571_mitsumeru⟧ (to stare).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{茫然|ぼうぜん}→茫然：09405_bouzen⟧: same pronunciation and very similar meaning; the two are often interchangeable. ⟦{茫然|ぼうぜん}→茫然：09405_bouzen⟧ may emphasize a more blank, vacant feeling.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {呆然|ぼうぜん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{立|た}ち{尽|つ}くす: to stand rooted in shock
- {呆然|ぼうぜん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to be dumbfounded
- {呆然自失|ぼうぜんじしつ}: stupefied, in a state of shock
